adjudicate(uint256,bool,string).details: PASS/FAIL moves to a challengeable state; funds move on `settle`      after the dispute window, or immediately if disputeWindow == 0.

params.bond: What the provider forfeits on FAIL.
params.deadline: Unix time by which the provider must deliver.
params.disputeWindow: Seconds after adjudication open to disputes.
params.feeBps: Protocol fee on price (PASS only), <= MAX_FEE_BPS.
params.price: What the buyer pays on PASS.
params.provider: Agent/provider who may post bond and deliver.
params.specHash: keccak256 of the frozen acceptance-spec JSON both sides confirmed.
params.token: ERC20 used for price + bond (e.g. USDT0 on X Layer).

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

adjudicate(uint256,bool,string).notice: Adjudicator reports the deterministic-evaluator verdict, exactly once.

claimNoShow(uint256).notice: Buyer is refunded AND collects the bond when the provider         bonded but never delivered by the deadline (no-show = FAIL).

createOrder(address,address,uint256,uint.notice: Buyer opens an order and funds the price in one step.

postBond(uint256).notice: Provider locks the bond. Order becomes workable.

raiseDispute(uint256).notice: Losing side freezes funds for re-review. No fee to raise (v1).

refundUnbonded(uint256).notice: Buyer reclaims price when the provider never bonded (past deadline).

resolveDispute(uint256,bool,string).notice: Adjudicator issues the final verdict after a dispute.

settle(uint256).notice: Moves funds after the dispute window elapsed with no dispute.

stateOf(uint256).notice: Current lifecycle state of an order (public getter returns a tuple).

submitDelivery(uint256,bytes32).notice: Provider commits to delivered bytes (hash only; bytes live off-chain + log).
